scripts.install: cd backend && npm install && cd ../app && npm install && npm install && npm install
scripts.dev: docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.docker.dev -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml up -d && docker image prune -f && cd app && npm run start
scripts.backend:dev: docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.docker.dev -f ./docker/docker-compose.yml up -d --build && docker image prune -f
scripts.backend: docker compose --env-file ./config/environment-variables/.env.docker.prod -f ./docker/docker-compose.prod.yml up -d && docker image prune
scripts.seed: cd backend && npx prisma migrate deploy && npx prisma db seed
